title: Spheroid Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Transfer spheroids to Akura plate
steps.instruction: Move spheroids from a standard U‑bottom 384‑well plate to the corresponding wells of a specialized Akura 384‑well plate, ensuring the system changes tips after every 16 columns and uses optimized flow rates and well positions to avoid shearing.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each sample to its matching well in the Akura plate.
Allow the robot to automatically change tips after 16 columns to match the new cell type.
Verify that flow rates and well positions are set to the optimized values for gentle spheroid handling.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the software interface before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the labware definition files (JSON format) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette; refer to the support articles for using calibration tips.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the spheroid transfer protocol.
